verdict.rationale: Fern Agent takes natural-language instructions and changes the docs source repo directly (e.g. "Move the SDK guides under Reference and fix the links"). It can be triggered from Slack or run on a schedule with prompts that open pull requests. The private Fern MCP server also lets a user's coding agent read sites, deployments and reader activity, and look up config syntax, conversationally from the terminal. Missing for 10: natural-language operation beyond docs editing (e.g. SDK generation or publishing) and independent or hands-on corroboration of Fern Agent's reliability.
